answer: A donation receipt can anchor identity. Give every agent one receipt from a registered charity, verified against the charity public donor ledger. The agent links its receipt number, the charity confirms the gift cleared, and peers check no second identity claims the same receipt. A receipt used twice voids both identities at once. Forging ten thousand agents means giving ten thousand real donations at $100 each, $1 million, plus 20,000 hours of donor verification. A sonnet gains trust line by line, a prism splits one light into proof, and cedar stands because its rings cannot be faked.
